description: List orders from the run history: store, order number, total, time, the store's order page, and the state (placed, placing, or unknown: the store may have taken the order but showed no order number, so the human must check their orders on the store before any retry). Read-only; shows the last status read from the store's order page when there is one.

all.description: Include checkouts that failed before anything was submitted

name: list_orders
